mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(to_peer_traffic), 0) AS sum_to_peer_traffic, COALESCE(SUM(from_peer_traffic), 0) AS sum_from_peer_traffic FROM ban_history WHERE populate_time > #{afterTimestamp} AND peer_ip <<= #{peerIp}::inet

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT torrent_id FROM ban_history WHERE peer_ip <<= #{peerIp}::inet AND populate_time >= #{afterTimestamp} UNION SELECT DISTINCT torrent_id FROM swarm_tracker WHERE peer_ip <<= #{peerIp}::inet AND last_time_seen >= #{afterTimestamp} ) AS torrents

SELECT COUNT(*) AS days30, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE populate_time > NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days') AS days14, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE populate_time > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS days7, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE populate_time > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 days') AS days1 FROM ban_history WHERE populate_time > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days';
